name: todo-api
description: Backend REST API for the collaborative to-do app. Owns lists, list membership and invitations, and tasks (title, due date, priority, completion, and who added/completed each one). Sits behind the gateway on the intranet boundary — the webapp is its only caller. Does not send email or push notifications; invitations are resolved in-app by matching the invited email to the signer-in user's account email.

dependencies.name: todo-db
dependencies.description: Stores lists, memberships, invitations, and tasks.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the caller's token and resolves the signed-in user's identity for every request.
